defects.title: All 44 Wave 11 taskcards show status=PENDING despite sprint being COMPLETE
defects.description: taskcards.json was created at the start of Lane 0 with all statuses PENDING. The taskcards were never updated as lanes completed. The sprint-closeout.json and lane-ledger.json both correctly show SPRINT_COMPLETE, but the taskcards file is contradictory.
defects.remediation: Lane A will update all 44 taskcards to COMPLETE with truthful evidence references

defects.title: Bundle SHA self-reference: closeout inside bundle has old SHA
defects.description: The evidence bundle at SHA 3113fd5c... was built AFTER the final sprint-closeout.json update that recorded the old SHA (10e56c...). So the sprint-closeout.json INSIDE the bundle still says sha256=10e56c613469d53e9dc3821920b67f0e74ce1180893b8b0cf9c95dea08bfae85 (from the first bundle run), but the actual bundle is 3113fd5c...
defects.remediation: Document defect clearly. Wave 12 final bundle will be authoritative; correct self-referential order implemented: build→SHA→update closeout→commit→rebuild→commit SHA update→rebuild final

defects.title: No commit proof in bundle — git show 861d73a not captured
defects.description: The evidence bundle does not contain a captured git-show output for the main Wave 11 commit (861d73a). Commit proof is necessary for independent verification without access to the live repo.
defects.remediation: Lane A: capture git show 861d73a > wave11-closeout-repair/commit-proof-861d73a.txt and include in Wave 12 bundle

defects.title: No final git status captured in bundle
defects.description: No file captures the git status at the time of Wave 11 bundle creation. This makes it impossible to verify the dirty-file baseline from outside the repo.
defects.remediation: Lane A: capture current git status into wave11-closeout-repair/final-git-status.txt

defects.title: Output artifact policy undocumented — .docx/.pdf etc not in bundle
defects.description: The bundle contains output-validation.json manifests but not the actual output artifacts (e.g., .docx, .pdf, .png). This is intentional (manifest-only policy for size) but was never formally documented.
defects.remediation: Lane A/B: write output-evidence-policy.json formally documenting MANIFEST_ONLY policy with rationale

defects.title: Wave 11 dryrun output-validation.json files not in bundle
defects.description: The _bundle.py INCLUDE_PATTERNS for Wave 11 include *.json files, so output-validation.json files should be present. However, if the dryrun output-validation.json files were named differently or placed in non-standard paths, they may be missing.
defects.remediation: Lane A: verify output-validation.json files are present for all 10 Wave 11 packages; re-bundle if any are missing

defects.title: canonical-package-ledger.json path ambiguous
defects.description: The canonical-package-ledger.json may exist at state/ or canonical-discovery/ path within the Wave 11 report. The path was not standardized.
defects.remediation: Lane G: standardize at state-docs/canonical-package-ledger.json with canonical path documented

defects.title: missing-url-ledger.json canonical URL hit rate (0/22) not surfaced
defects.description: 22 MISSING_CANONICAL_URL entries remain. The missing-url-ledger.json was created but doesn't explicitly state that the URL hit rate was 0/22 (no URLs discovered in Wave 11).
defects.remediation: Lane D: explicitly state Wave 11 URL hit rate = 0/22 in Wave 12 canonical-discovery results

defects.title: wave12-next-queue references svg entries without package-proof yet
defects.description: The wave12-next-queue.json correctly identifies svg/svg-to-pdf-converter and svg/vectorizer as needing package-proof in Wave 12. This is a known planned item, not a true defect, but confirms these 2 packages must be proven in Wave 12 Lane C.
defects.remediation: Lane C: build packages for both svg entries; Lane G: update wave13-next-queue.json
